title: staleCaption
description: Generates PRD section 7.4's caption line for a stale node: sourceSlug.member changed Xh ago. Re-review required.
signature: function staleCaption(stale: RawStaleness | undefined, sourceSlug: string | undefined, nowMs: number): string | undefined
semantics: Formats the stale node caption, computed at draw time per PRD section 0.4.
